description: Gets one Siena dinner in full: date and time, where it happens, table size, seat price, the booking window and the cancellation rule. The restaurant stays private until Siena emails it on the Wednesday before.

dinner_id.description: The dinner id from list_upcoming_dinners, for example "london-2026-11-05". A Thursday date such as "2026-11-05" also works.

name: get_dinner

booking_status.description: open: a seat can be booked now. not_open_yet: booking opens on the Wednesday two weeks before. closed: booking closed on the Tuesday before.

amount.description: Seat price in the currency's main unit.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 with the London UTC offset.

title: Get a Siena dinner
